notes:
Snapshot of deal and POC requirements:
- Company: StratusNexus Labs — mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B).
- Current path: started on Redwood Hosted API; good traction in dev + early prod. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency/cost.
- POC ask (priority): Dedicated two-week canary followed by staged rollout. Canary plan: week 1 -> 10% traffic (customer-facing search + support flows), week 2 -> 50% traffic. Post-POC goal: decision to commit to 1y reserved capacity or continue Hosted + burst.
- Fallback & routing requirements: must have automated fallback to Hosted API in same region if Dedicated pool reports backend errors or p95 latency > 200ms for >2 minutes. Regional failover required: primary us-west, failover eu-west for EU traffic. Stated: "must not surface errors to end-users; silent fallback only."
- Model variants: prefer a quantized 8-bit variant for cost-sensitive routes (reranking + embeddings preprocessing) and fp16 for high-quality chat responses. Want ability to pin model family and allow automated downgrade to a smaller variant under capacity pressure.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 generation <120ms on 1k token avg (support snippets), peak throughput ~25 QPS for search endpoints.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, tracing for canary requests, error rate alerts. SE wants to hook Redwood Console into their Datadog.
- Security/compliance: require SOC2, SSO (Okta/SAML), KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs retained 90 days, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — product team will trade small quality drop for 2–3x cost savings on high-volume endpoints. Finance wants committed discount tiers; asked for modeled ARR impact for 12/24-month commits.
- POC success criteria (customer-defined): canary meets latency SLO (p95 <120ms), no functional regressions in 2000 prompt regression set, fallback executes within 10s of failure, cost-per-1k-tokens within modeled budget.
- Rollback plan: immediate traffic cutover back to Hosted API + invalidate Dedicated routing config; SE to run a canary rollback runbook (steps documented in drive).
- Quotes from call: "We need a safety net — if the Dedicated pool hiccups we can't degrade support SLAs." — Ana Ruiz (Head of Eng).
- Stubs/links: pricing deck (drive), security FAQ, sample prompt set for regression tests (attached).
- Internal notes: AE/Jordan to push for a 2-week trial with a conditional discount if POC passes. Finance asks for examples of previous mid-market Dedicated deals (send case studies).
- Open questions: network egress estimates for quantized pipelines, exact burst policy and autoscale ceilings, whether Redwood can provide a short-term trial contract for dedicated burst without 12mo commit.
